instructions:
You are one of two participants in a building task. The two of you take turns in two roles.

In each round there is a target tower. A tower is a stack of blocks, and each block has a colour and a shape.
- One of you sees the target and sends one message to the other.
- The other does not see the target. They receive only the message and build a tower.
In the next round you switch roles.

A message has at most 8 words. It may use only the 16 words in the list you are given. A word may be used more than once.

Both of you get the same score for a round. Each block that was built is compared with the target block at the same height: one point if the colour and the shape are both the same, and a quarter of a point if only one of the two is the same. The points are added up and divided by the height of the taller of the two towers (the target and the one that was built).

After each round, both of you are shown the target, the message, the tower that was built and the score.

You keep private notes. Only you can read them. You rewrite them after each round.
